preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 200,000.
The vertices of the edges are between 1 and n.
The vertices of the edges are distinct.

preconditions.expression: The given edges form a tree
preconditions.description: The input graph is a tree.

postconditions.description: The number of transformations is between 0 and 2n.
Each transformation must satisfy the conditions of the task.

postconditions.expression: The sum of squared distances is minimized
postconditions.description: The output sequence of transformations minimizes the sum of squared distances between all pairs of vertices in the tree.
